description: Full Jira-ticket quality linter (whole ticket, not just AC - use acceptance_criteria_validator for the deep AC pass). POST one ticket or a batch (max 50) and get per-ticket findings with severity + concrete fixes: missing/weak summary or description, missing AC or estimate, bugs without repro/expected-vs-actual/environment, missing epic link, points-vs-hours mismatch, oversized estimates to split, urgent-but-thin tickets. Returns score, grade, and a ready/needs_work verdict per ticket plus batch summary. Type-aware rules (story/bug/task/epic/subtask), strict profile available. Deterministic, no LLM.

profile.description: Default "normal" (ready at 75). "strict" bumps severities and needs 85.

ticket.description: One Jira-style ticket. Missing fields ARE findings, so send what you have.

acceptance_criteria.description: A list, or one string with one criterion per line.

attachments_count.description: Number of attachments; 0 on a bug is flagged.

issue_type.description: story, bug, task, epic or subtask; anything else is linted as a task.

priority.description: e.g. "High". highest/blocker with a thin description is flagged.

story_points.description: Estimate in points; cross-checked against estimate_hours.

tickets.description: Alternative: batch of up to 50 tickets. Send ticket or tickets, not both.

name: ticket_lint
